assets.label: Sculpted Sage
assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: InfiniChat iOS app icon, one single square finished artwork.
Input images: Image 1 is the visual reference for the existing Sage Ribbon icon. Create a closely related new variation. Preserve its fundamental horizontal infinity loop with a conversation-bubble tail, calm sage and deep forest palette, front-facing presentation, and dimensional character. The user specifically likes the shadows and depth.
Composition: single optically centered large mark, two generous open counters, comfortable even margins. Background fills the whole square. Strong silhouette that reads at small icon sizes.
Primary change: deepen the sculptural bevel of the sage infinity-chat form. Keep a broad clean front face, softly rounded bevels, darker recessed inner sidewalls, and a clearly defined shadow at the central crossover. Keep the bottom-right chat tail short, integrated and visibly pointed; make its silhouette a little more deliberate than the reference.
Material and lighting: matte satin ceramic in sage #B6D6A9, gentle pale green highlights from upper left, restrained dark green occlusion in the folds. A very subtle short shadow behind the form anchors its depth.
Background: uniform deep forest #171C18. Calm, minimal, dimensional, carefully designed.
Constraints: one finished icon only, square and fully opaque; no rounded outside corners, no tile within the image, no device mockup, no text, no labels, no watermark, no additional decorative objects, no glow or sparkles. Preserve the essence of the reference. Render smooth controlled shading, without grain or noisy texture.
